title: Majestic 12
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Majestic 12, about 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, this is like a reported committee in the in the I guess 40s and 50s and like, you know, Nathan Twining, James Forrestal, Vannevar Bush, people like that.

plain: Majestic 12, sometimes written MJ-12, is said to have been a secret committee of top American officials in the 1940s and 1950s, set up to handle the UFO question. Jesse Michels describes it in passing as a "reported committee", and names some of the men said to have sat on it: the Air Force general Nathan Twining, the first Secretary of Defense James Forrestal, and the government science chief Vannevar Bush. If such a group existed, it would mean UFOs were being handled at the very top of the US government from the start.
